title: OpenAI and Visa partner to let AI agents make purchases online after users give their permission and to explore enterprise applications for AI-driven payments (Paige Smith/Bloomberg)
summary: Paige Smith / Bloomberg: OpenAI and Visa partner to let AI agents make purchases online after users give their permission and to explore enterprise applications for AI-driven payments — OpenAI and Visa Inc. are now allowing artificial-intelligence agents to make purchases online after users give their permission …
